params.name: from
params.description: Unix timestamp (seconds). Fetch records created on or after this time.

params.name: to
params.description: Unix timestamp (seconds). Fetch records created on or before this time.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of records to return per call. Maximum 100. Default 10.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of records to skip. Use with count for pagination. Default 0.

params.name: expand[]
params.description: Set to ondemand_payouts to include payout details.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of all on-demand instant settlements. Use expand[]=ondemand_payouts to include individual payout records inline.
Request an on-demand (instant) settlement of your available Razorpay balance to your bank account. Fees apply. Use settle_full_balance=true to settle everything available, or specify an amount.

params.name: expand[]
params.description: Set to ondemand_payouts to include payout details.

items.docs: Retrieve details of a specific on-demand instant settlement. Use expand[]=ondemand_payouts to include payout records.
